data.name: GracePeriodAndChargesHelp
data.value:
Grace Period and Charges: This section allows you to specify grace period and charges associated with the loan application. Here's an overview of the key components:
Key Points: 1. Apply Charges: Check this box if charges are applicable to this loan. 2. Charge Rate (%): Enter the percentage of charges applicable to the loan amount. 3. Number of Days to Apply Charges: Enter the number of days within which charges should be applied after the due date. 4. Grace Period Before First Payment: Enter the grace period, in months, before the first repayment installment is due. 5. Grace Period After Maturity Date: Enter the grace period, in days, after the entire loan becomes overdue. By specifying these parameters accurately, you can ensure clarity regarding charges and grace periods associated with the loan, facilitating smooth loan management and repayment.

data.name: InterestHelp
data.value: Interest: This section allows you to specify interest-related details for the loan application. Here's an overview of the key components: Key Points: 1. Amortization Type: Select the type of amortization for the loan. 2. Interest Rate: Enter the interest rate applicable to the loan. 3. Apply Interest Waiver: Check this box if an interest waiver is applicable to this application. 4. Waiver Rate (%): If applicable, enter the percentage of interest waiver. By accurately specifying these details, you can ensure transparency and clarity regarding interest-related terms, facilitating informed decision-making for both the borrower and the lender.

data.name: LoanApprovalAndProcessing
data.value: Loan approval and processing are subject to verification of borrower credentials and compliance with regulatory requirements.

data.name: LoanProductHelp
data.value: Loan Product: This section allows you to select the appropriate loan product for the loan application. Here's a breakdown of the key components: Key Points: 1. Select Loan Product Dropdown: Use this dropdown menu to choose the specific loan product that best fits the borrower's needs. The available options are populated based on the loan products available in the system. 2. Select Loan Type Dropdown: This dropdown menu enables you to specify the type of loan being applied for. It could be a personal loan, business loan, mortgage, etc. 3. Amount: Enter the desired loan amount in this field. 4. Loan Duration: Specify the intended duration of the loan in months or years. 5. Help Icon: Click on the help icon (ℹ️) next to the "Loan Product" heading for additional assistance and guidance on selecting the most suitable loan product for the borrower's needs. By carefully selecting the appropriate loan product and terms in this section, you can ensure that the loan meets the borrower's needs while also aligning with their financial capabilities and objectives.

data.name: PurposeAndActivitiesHelp
data.value: Purpose and Activities: This section allows you to specify the purpose of the loan and associated economic activities. Here's an overview of the key components: Key Points: 1. Purpose of Taken Loan: Select the purpose for which the loan is being taken. 2. Economic Activity: Choose the economic activity associated with the loan. By accurately defining the purpose and activities, you ensure alignment between the loan's objectives and the borrower's intended use of funds.

data.name: RepaymentAndLoanDurationHelp
data.value: Repayment and Loan Duration: This section allows you to specify repayment-related details and the duration of the loan. Here's an overview of the key components: Key Points: 1. Repayment Cycle: Select the repayment cycle for the loan. 2. Number of Repayments: Enter the total number of repayments, if applicable. By accurately specifying these details, you can establish clear repayment terms and ensure that the loan duration aligns with the borrower's financial capabilities and preferences.

data.name: RiskMitigationHelp
data.value: Risk Mitigation: This section allows you to specify risk mitigation measures associated with the loan application. Here's an overview of the key components: Key Points: 1. Collateral: Check this box if the borrower has provided collateral for the loan. 2. Guarantor: Check this box if the borrower has provided a guarantor for the loan. 3. Share Account Coverage Amount: Enter the amount covered by the borrower's share account, if applicable. 4. Saving Account Coverage Rate: Specify the coverage rate provided by the borrower's saving account, if applicable. 5. Salary Account Coverage Rate: Enter the coverage rate provided by the borrower's salary account, if applicable. By carefully considering and implementing appropriate risk mitigation measures in this section, you can minimize the potential losses associated with the loan and protect the interests of the lender.
